newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi index rises slightly on financial interest.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi index rises slightly on financial interest.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index rose on Monday with gains for some shares in the financial and industrial sectors, brokers said.
The index rose 3.51 points to stand at 3064.40 and turnover was posted at 8.690 million shillings on 364,106 shares from 21.653 million shillings on 797,811 shares on Friday.
An official said trading was fairly quiet. Most stocks were stable with only small lots being traded.
Brokers said investors were mainly interested in financials with some demand for Barclays Bank, Kenya Commercial Bank, Housing Finance and National Bank of Kenya.
Barclays Bank rose to 109 but eased back to 105, the same as its Friday close, Housing Finance gained to 26 from 25.25. National Bank of Kenya traded 179,325 shares at 18.50, 18 and 18.20 from 18.45.
National carrier Kenya Airways eased 25 cents to close at 11.20 on 47,350 shares.
Among industrials, East African Oxygen gained to 65 from 62.50, Kenya Breweries fell 6.0 shillings to 47 and oil concern Total Kenya eased to 72 from 73.
